reasons.plausibility: The hypothesized ordering-driven embrittlement and recovery pathways are scientifically coherent for a similar AlCoCrFeNi2.1 system, but they do not address Mg-containing alloys or corrosion/oxidation behavior as requested.
reasons.testability: The proposed TKD/TEM observations of dislocation piles and boundary morphology provide a concrete, feasible way to confirm orrefute the mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: Because it omits Mg effects and does not address corrosion/oxidation, it has only limited relevance to the original question about Mg-containing lightweight HEAs.
